result: If I could make one fundamental shift in the world, I would cultivate a widespread ethos of empathy—an active effort to genuinely understand and care for one another’s well-being. This empathy wouldn’t be mere politeness or a surface-level kindness, but a real willingness to see others’ situations as our own, and to act with compassion. I believe that with enough empathy we’d more naturally address issues like inequality, environmental degradation, and conflict, because we’d no longer accept that it’s “someone else’s problem.” That single shift—an expanded sense of shared responsibility—could ripple through every sphere of life, guiding more humane policies, technological innovations, and individual choices.
